## Summary

One sentence describing what you want added or changed.

## Problem it solves

What use case does this enable? What limitation does it remove?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you think it should work. If you have a specific implementation
in mind, sketch it out here.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you ruled them out.

## Would you be willing to implement this?

- [ ] Yes, I can open a PR
- [ ] I can help test it
- [ ] No, just suggesting
